title: Alternating Eulerian–Catalan identity for odd n
statement:
Let $n$ be odd. Write $
vDash[n]$ for compositions of $[n]$, let $phi$ range over odd compositions, let $mu_{ell(phi)+1}$ denote the relevant Catalan-number coefficient, and let $E(n,k)$ be the number of permutations of $n$ with $k$ descents.

**Alternating Eulerian–Catalan identity.**

$$
\sum_{\phi\vDash[n] \atop \phi\text{ is odd}}2^{n-\ell(\phi)}\mu_{\ell(\phi)+1}=\sum_{0\leq k\leq n-1}(-1)^kE(n,k).
$$

This identity is reported as an unproved relation between Catalan numbers and Eulerian numbers and is described as irrelevant to the main result of the section.
source_name: Farid Aliniaeifard and Shu Xiao Li, “The peak algebra in noncommuting variables”, arXiv:2506.12868 (2025).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.12868

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2025).
